    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    k = int(next(it))
    query = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    access = [0] * 81
    for book in query:
        access[book] += 1

    available_books = set()
    cost = 0
    removable = -1

    for i in range(n):
        current_book = query[i]
        does_not_contain = current_book not in available_books
        if does_not_contain:
            cost += 1

        if removable != -1:
            available_books.remove(removable)
            removable = -1
        elif len(available_books) == k and does_not_contain:
            removable_book = -1
            count = k
            known = set()
            j = i + 1
            while j < n and count > 0:
                book = query[j]
                if book in available_books and book not in known:
                    count -= 1
                    known.add(book)
                    removable_book = book
                j += 1
            if removable_book != -1:
                available_books.remove(removable_book)
            else:
                available_books.pop()

        available_books.add(current_book)
        access[current_book] -= 1
        if access[current_book] == 0:
            removable = current_book

    sys.stdout.write(str(cost) + "\n")

    solve()
